# Demo scenario registry

<!-- Generated by `python -m demos registry --write` from demos/scenarios/registry.py. Do not edit. -->

**1 recorded, 2 recorded in part (an act was skipped and is listed in its manifest), 0 scripted (not yet recorded), 5 unscripted (every lane it needs has landed; no script exists yet), 4 blocked** on lanes that have not landed ([ADR-0048](../../docs/adr/0048-scenario-dependency-gating.md)).

| Scenario | Status | Waits for | Story |
|---|---|---|---|
| `assurance_loop` — The assurance loop: intent to applied baseline | recorded-partial | nothing | A vague request becomes explicit meanings; the owner selects one; the rule is exercised as different synthetic actors (including denials); evidence is computed; the owner approves the exact revision, then separately applies it. Needs no other lane: it is the shipped v0.2 flow. |
| `ide_walkthrough` — The IDE walkthrough: EIJA reviews a change to itself | recorded-partial | nothing | Connected read-only to its own checkout, EIJA shows the model of its review workflow, follows a concept into its exact source, turns a plain-language request into an owner-selected meaning, reviews the before/after model change, previews a kernel-checked edit without writing it, exercises the rules as an agent and the owner, and shows verification blocked until the owner reviews changed source. |
| `playide_tour` — The PlayIDE tour: design, build, simulate and check an AI's change | recorded | nothing | On the library-loan pack, PlayIDE shows the state machine, class, use case and component diagrams and the screen designer; builds and runs the app with its conformance cases; simulates users; draws a state and a transition from the palette; and checks an offline AI proposal step by step, rejecting the step the policy refuses, before building and simulating the result. |
| `agent_change_review` — Reviewing an agent's change by meaning, not by diff | unscripted | nothing | An agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or Gemini via MCP) proposes; the developer sees the meaning, the ripple into other models and the evidence - and the agent cannot approve. |
| `visual_diff_and_ripple` — Change a rule, watch the generated UML diff and ripple | unscripted | nothing | Before/after state machine, commit sequence and impact graph generated from the executable model, with added/removed/changed elements highlighted. |
| `uml_drag_and_drop` — Drag and drop UML that stays true to the code | blocked | `uml-editor` (wave 2) | Edit the state diagram on a canvas; each gesture issues the same typed semantic transaction as the rule table, so the picture and the code cannot disagree. |
| `ubiquitous_language_ddd_tree` — Ubiquitous language and a DDD tree | blocked | `ddd-language` (wave 2) | Define terms once; watch contexts, aggregates and invariants form a navigable tree linked to code and to the OKF wiki. |
| `image_generation_in_studio` — Generate images inside the Studio | blocked | `imagegen` (wave 2) | Consent-gated image generation for journey and persona artefacts, kept as untrusted provider output like every other proposal. |
| `e2e_tests_personas_icp` — Personas, ICP and the e2e tests behind them | blocked | `personas-e2e` (wave 2) | Personas and the ideal customer profile drive generated e2e scenarios, shown next to the running app and the UML behind it. |
| `formal_vv_tour` — Formal V&V tour: Bend, TLA+, Z3, properties, mutation | unscripted | nothing | Each technique checks the same model; a deliberately unsafe variant fails in each, and every claim states what it does not prove. |
| `metrics_and_hci_dashboard` — Quantitative metrics and HCI-law budgets | unscripted | nothing | Package metrics, complexity, latency against the Doherty threshold, Fitts/Hick/KLM budgets. |
| `okf_wiki_tour` — The OKF wiki, deterministically linked to code | unscripted | nothing | Follow a concept page to the exact code it describes; change the code and watch the page go stale in the gate. |

Every wave-1 lane has landed on the integration branch; the lanes a blocked scenario waits for are wave-2 capabilities the owner asked to demo that no wave-1 lane delivers.
